svg.title: Billiard Factory — Shopify Plus commerce transition
svg.desc: An official Shopify logo on charcoal, three actual Billiard Factory room and product photographs, and the status Migration in progress. The current storefront is live; the migration is ongoing.
svg.metadata: Logo source: https://www.shopify.com/brand-assets. Official inverted primary logo embedded unchanged. Photography: existing Billiard Factory fall assets. Composition created for Untold Works, October 4, 2026.
